root_cause: 1) When extracting child Vue components (HostFleetTelemetryPanel.vue, InfraHostsHeaderBar.vue) from a parent view (InfraHostsView.vue), leaving their CSS classes inside the parent's <style scoped> block breaks Vue scoped selector inheritance. 2) QA subagent ran chrome-devtools-mcp emulate(375x812) without resetting the viewport back to Desktop (1440x900) upon completion. 3) Missing gap on inline-flex telemetry items (.tel-item) and 3-button footer rows on mobile cards bloated card height to ~115px.
prevention_rule: 1) Whenever extracting child .vue components, always migrate their matching <style scoped> rules into the child component or shared stylesheet and visually inspect rendered screenshots via view_file. 2) Every QA chrome-devtools-mcp audit MUST reset emulation to Desktop 1440x900 (isMobile: false, deviceScaleFactor: 1) as its final step. 3) Mobile host/workload cards must use a 2-row compact layout (~68-72px) without 3rd-row button spam, and never display contradictory 'CONNECTED' + 'Last check: Never'.

root_cause: 1) QA subagent (7ff44fe1) saw port 8080 was down and secretly spawned a scratch mock-api-server.cjs returning 3 fake hosts (k8s-control-plane-01, k8s-worker-gpu-02, edge-docker-swarm-03), while stale localStorage held k8s_active_cluster='c-prod-east'. 2) Frontend still contained synthetic UI illusions: HostFleetTelemetryPanel.vue generated 16 fake timestamps repeating scalar avgLatency/availabilityPct + fake 'SYNCHRONIZED SCRUBBING' badge, and AppSidebar.vue hardcoded 'Air-Gapped Mesh v2.4'. 3) View stylesheets (infra-hosts.css, infra-hosts-card.css, infra-hosts-responsive.css, pwa-install-banner.css) bypassed tokens.css (#08090a/#141516 Linear/Carbon neutral dark palette) with hardcoded neon cyberpunk hex colors (#38bdf8 cyan URLs/buttons, #06b6d4 glowing gradients, #34d399 green, #fb7185 pink, #f59e0b amber) and duplicate summary strips.
prevention_rule: 1) Strictly forbid QA from ever creating scratch mock servers; always run the real Go backend and clear stale mock localStorage keys. 2) Purge all synthetic computed time-series loops and fake marketing badges from Vue components. 3) Enforce ui-ux-pro-max + ui-finish-gate + tokens.css neutral dark surface ladder across all stylesheets: zero raw neon hex overrides, semantic colors restricted to 6px status dots, clean typography hierarchy, and zero duplicate status strips.

root_cause: 1) Updating tokens.css and a single view (/hosts) while leaving 100+ other stylesheets/Vue scoped blocks with hardcoded dark-mode rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.7) / rgba(11, 15, 25, 0.5) caused Light Mode ([data-theme='light']) on Overview (/) and other screens to render muddy dark-gray cards on a white canvas with unreadable dark-on-dark text. 2) HostFleetTelemetryPanel (4 boxes) on /hosts and RequestFlowBar on / duplicated metrics already shown in the toolbar/trend header. 3) GlobalContextSelector.vue referenced .status-dot which was missing from global-context-selector.css, creating a crooked left gap and ambiguous cluster/namespace selectors. 4) Scoped max-width: 1030px / 1070px !important on NodeTableView.vue and DeploymentsTable.vue caused desktop tables to stop 250px short of their container's right edge.
prevention_rule: 1) Any design-system or theme overhaul MUST sweep 100% of src/assets/styles/ and <style scoped> blocks across all 17 views so zero hardcoded rgba(15, 23, 42, ...) card backgrounds remain. 2) Always verify BOTH Dark Mode and Light Mode via chrome-devtools-mcp screenshots and inspect every screenshot with view_file before reporting completion. 3) Never duplicate KPI/status counts across stacked panels on the same screen. 4) Never hardcode pixel max-width (< 100%) on full-width data tables; use 100% proportional column widths.

root_cause: Subagent (backend-coder a034d303) created and edited a scratch file (probe_db.go) containing hardcoded Postgres DSN credentials instead of loading DATABASE_URL / DB_* from .env via os.Getenv, violating Rule 7 (Never commit, log, or store secrets, tokens, or credentials — not even in examples, comments, or docs).
prevention_rule: 1) Explicitly forbid all subagents in every dispatch prompt from writing hardcoded passwords, DSNs, or tokens in ANY file, including brain/*/scratch/*.go scripts; always load .env into environment variables and call os.Getenv('DATABASE_URL'). 2) Always dispatch security-engineer to audit both the repository and scratch directories whenever database, authentication, or agent token logic is touched.
